subject: Control System
questionText:
A second order system with no zeros has its poles 
located at –3+j4 and –3–j4 in the s-plane. The 
undamped natural frequency and the damping ratio of 
the system are respectively 
 
(a) 5 rad/s and 0.60 
(b) 3rad/ s and 0.60 
 
(c) 5 rad /s and 0.80 
(d) 3 rad / s and 0.80
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-06 (Time Response Analysis (Part-3&4)).
